title: How robust is a disparity estimate?
text: Every quantity computed four recorded numbers per area, year group: group’s recorded stops g, White recorded stops w, Census 2021 resident populations P_g P_w; u number recorded stops recorded ethnicity. Rate per 1,000 residents: 1000 * g / P_g 1000 * w / P_w. Ratio: (g / P_g) / (w / P_w), withheld w zero populations comparable. 95% interval: exp(log(ratio) ± 1.96 * sqrt(1/g + 1/w)), positive counts. treats counts independent Poisson counts fixed denominators. Allocation range: ratio_min = (g / P_g) / ((w + u) / P_w) ratio_max = ((g + u) / P_g) / (w / P_w). split unknown stops two groups, remainder groups, ratio lies . Rank bounds: force’s best rank one plus number eligible forces whose ratio_min exceeds ratio_max; worst rank one plus number whose ratio_max exceeds ratio_min. Rank interval: draw g* ~ Poisson(g) w* ~ Poisson(w) every eligible force, rank simulated ratios, repeat draws times, take 2.5th 97.5th percentiles force’s rank; prob_top share draws force ranks within top top. Change years: ratio_to / ratio_from interval exp(log(change) ± 1.96 * sqrt(1/g_1 + 1/w_1 + 1/g_2 + 1/w_2)).
